title: Is Grokking a Loss of Normal Hyperbolicity of the Interpolation Manifold?
abstract: arXiv:2608.14803v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A recent line of work recasts the post-memorization phase of grokking as constrained optimization: once a network interpolates the training set, weight decay drives a slow drift along the zero-loss manifold toward lower norm. In the language of dynamical systems, this is a fast-slow system in which the interpolation manifold plays the role of a slow manifold. We ask a question that this framing makes natural but the existing literature does not address: is the sharp generalization transition a loss of normal hyperbolicity of that manifold: a fold- or bifurcation-like event in which a normal restoring direction goes flat? Or does the manifold stay uniformly attracting while generalization happens by smooth drift? We propose a simple, optimizer-agnostic diagnostic: the smallest nonzero singular value $\sigma_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$ of the residual Jacobian, which, for the squared loss, equals the slowest normal restoring rate of the manifol

translated_title: 《Grokking是否意味着插值流形的法向双曲性丧失？》
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14803v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：最近一系列研究将grokking的记忆后阶段重新诠释为约束优化问题：一旦网络插值训练集，权重衰减驱动沿零损失流形向低范数方向的缓慢漂移。在动力系统语言中，这是一个快慢系统，其中插值流形扮演慢流形的角色。我们提出了一个此框架自然引出但现有文献未涉及的问题：尖锐的泛化转变是否是该流形法向双曲性的丧失——即法向恢复方向变平坦的折叠或分岔类事件？还是流形保持均匀吸引，而泛化通过平滑漂移发生？我们提出一个简单且与优化器无关的诊断方法：残差雅可比矩阵的最小非零奇异值 $\sigma_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$，对于平方损失，这等于流形的最慢法向恢复率。
tldr: 本文提出用残差雅可比矩阵的最小非零奇异值作为诊断工具，来区分grokking中的尖锐泛化转变是由流形法向双曲性丧失（折叠或分岔事件）引起，还是流形保持吸引而泛化通过平滑漂移实现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using the smallest nonzero singular value of the residual Jacobian as a diagnostic to distinguish whether the sharp generalization transition in grokking arises from a loss of normal hyperbolicity of the interpolation manifold (a fold or bifurcation event) or from smooth drift while the manifold remains uniformly attracting.
